contentEn:
In 2026, a bathroom renovation in Coquitlam, BC costs between $14,000 for a basic refresh and $55,000+ for a full luxury renovation. The final cost depends on the scope: a simple tub-to-shower conversion in a Coquitlam condo runs $14,000–$17,000, a mid-range full bathroom in a Coquitlam townhouse typically runs $22,000–$35,000, and a high-end master bathroom with curbless shower, heated floors, and custom tile can reach $45,000–$55,000. Reno Stars has completed bathroom projects in Coquitlam using real completed-project budgets.

What Drives Bathroom Renovation Cost in Coquitlam in 2026

  • Condo vs. single-family — Coquitlam has a large condo market (Austin Station, Newport Village, Canyon Springs). Condo bathrooms are typically smaller (30–50 sq ft) and easier to renovate. Single-family homes in Coquitlam (e.g. in Scott Creek, Eagle Ridge) tend to have larger bathrooms (60–100+ sq ft) with more complex layouts requiring structural consideration.
  • Building permits — Coquitlam falls under the City of Coquitlam's Building Department. A plumbing or electrical permit is required for any fixture relocation, waterproofing work, or structural changes. Permit fees in Coquitlam are calculated as a percentage of the estimated construction value, typically $1,000–$2,500 for a standard bathroom renovation.
  • Strata considerations — Many Coquitlam condos have strata bylaws that restrict work hours, require噪音 (noise) notifications, and mandate designated contractors for common elements. Reno Stars is familiar with Coquitlam strata requirements and handles the paperwork.
  • Material costs — Tile, fixtures, and vanity costs are consistent across Metro Vancouver. Coquitlam has access to the same supplier network as Vancouver and Burnaby. Premium finishes (heated floors, frameless glass, custom millwork) add $5,000–$15,000 to a mid-range project.
  • Trade availability — Coquitlam sits in the heart of the Tri-Cities. Plumbers, electricians, and tilers are readily available, keeping subcontractor costs competitive compared to downtown Vancouver.

Coquitlam Bathroom Renovation: Permit Requirements

In the City of Coquitlam, a building permit is required for bathroom renovations that involve:

  • Any change to plumbing locations (moving a toilet, vanity, or shower)
  • Electrical work beyond simple fixture replacement (adding heated floors, new vanity lighting, or a Bluetooth speaker system)
  • Waterproofing work in a shower or wet area
  • Removal of load-bearing walls (rare in standard bathroom renovations)
  • Any work that changes the size of an existing opening or adds new openings in walls

Cosmetic-only work — painting, flooring replacement, and installing a new vanity in the same location — typically does not require a permit in Coquitlam. Reno Stars manages all permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

  • Condo full refresh (new vanity, tile, toilet, faucet): 2–3 weeks
  • Mid-range townhouse or single-family bathroom: 3–5 weeks
  • High-end master bathroom with curbless shower and custom tile: 5–8 weeks

Frequently Asked Questions — Coquitlam Bathroom Renovation

How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Coquitlam in 2026?

A bathroom renovation in Coquitlam costs between $14,000 for a basic tub-to-shower conversion in a condo and $55,000+ for a full luxury master bathroom with curbless shower, heated floors, and custom tile. A mid-range full bathroom in a Coquitlam townhouse or single-family home typically runs $22,000–$35,000. All prices from completed Reno Stars projects include labour, materials, permits where required, and our 3-year workmanship warranty.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Coquitlam?

You need a permit for any plumbing relocation, electrical upgrades beyond simple fixture swaps, waterproofing work, or structural changes in Coquitlam. Cosmetic work — new vanity, faucet, and flooring in the same locations — typically does not require a permit. Reno Stars handles all City of Coquitlam permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Coquitlam?

A condo tub-to-shower conversion takes 1–2 weeks. A mid-range full bathroom refresh takes 2–3 weeks for a condo or 3–5 weeks for a townhouse or single-family home. A high-end master bathroom with curbless shower, custom tile, and heated floors takes 5–8 weeks.

Does Reno Stars work in Coquitlam condos with strata requirements?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed bathroom projects in Coquitlam condos including Newport Village and Canyon Springs. We handle all strata notifications, work-hour restrictions, and contractor documentation required by Coquitlam strata corporations.

What is the average bathroom renovation cost in Coquitlam compared to Vancouver?

Coquitlam bathroom renovations typically cost 10–20% less than comparable projects in Vancouver. A mid-range full bathroom that costs $28,000–$35,000 in Vancouver usually runs $22,000–$30,000 in Coquitlam, primarily due to lower strata and permit fees and slightly less congestion in the trade market.
